title_sq: Shitet apartament 1+1 ne rrugen Mine Peza , Tirane.
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 1+1 ne rrugen Mine Peza. 
Ndodhet ne katin e dyte te nje pallati ekzistues, perballe me shkollen Harry Fulz. 
Organizohet nga dhoma e madhe ndenjieje me kendin e kuzhines, nje dhome gjumi, nje tualet, korridor si edhe ballkon.
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale on Mine Peza street, Tirana.
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale on Mine Peza street. It is located on the second floor of an existing building, opposite the Harry Fulz school. It is organized by a large living room with a kitchen corner, a bedroom, a toilet, a corridor and a balcony.
